SUBHADEEP BATABYAL
Bengaluru, India | +91-9614546503 | subhadeepbatabyal06@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/subhadeep-batabyal-b89ab787
NETWORK OPERATIONS ENGINEER | IP NETWORKING | TELECOM BACKBONE | OPTICAL &
TRANSMISSION OPS | INCIDENT MANAGEMENT
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Network Infrastructure and Operations Engineer with 8+ years of experience in large-scale IP networking, telecom transmission
systems, network security operations, enterprise WAN environments, and critical incident management across global customer
infrastructures. Strong expertise in TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, Layer2/Layer3 routing, enterprise circuits, ISP backbone
coordination, packet loss/latency diagnostics, VPN technologies, and systematic troubleshooting methodologies.
Experienced in handling high-severity outages in 24x7 NOC environments, coordinating with telecom providers, engineering teams,
and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure service restoration, uptime, and root cause elimination. Hands-on exposure to
optical/backhaul transmission systems, EMS/NMS style monitoring workflows, and large-scale internet service operations.
CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS
Routing / Protocols: TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VLAN, STP, ARP, ICMP, DHCP, DNS, NAT, Layer2/Layer3 Troubleshooting,
SDWAN basics
Telecom / Backbone: Enterprise Circuits, DWDM/Transmission Exposure, ISP Coordination, WAN Routing, Link Failover, Latency
& Packet Loss Analysis, Optical Backhaul Validation
Network Security: Zscaler ZIA/ZPA/ZDX, Ivanti Pulse Secure VPN, GRE/IPSec, SSL VPN, SAML, Okta, Duo MFA, Proxy,
Certificates
Wireless / Infra: Aruba Central, ArubaOS, WLAN Controllers, RF Diagnostics, 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax
Packet / Log Analysis: Wireshark, tcpdump, MTR, iPerf, Fiddler, RCA, Incident Analysis, Traceroute Validation
Cloud / Monitoring: AWS, Azure, Active Directory, NSS/LSS, EMS/NMS Monitoring Concepts, Public Cloud Connectivity
Operations: P1/P2 Incident Handling, NOC Escalation, Shift Operations, SLA Management, Change Validation, Cross-functional
Collaboration
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
ZSCALER — Senior Technical Support Engineer / Network Security Engineer | Apr 2025 – Present

Troubleshoot large-scale enterprise secure access and cloud edge network deployments across ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, Browser
Isolation, NSS/LSS, and traffic forwarding platforms.

Perform packet-level diagnosis for TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, ARP, SSL, GRE, and IPSec related failures impacting global
enterprise users and branch connectivity.

Validate routing path issues, PAC forwarding logic, tunnel establishment, cloud log streaming, and proxy traffic steering using
systematic troubleshooting workflows.

Coordinate with ISP teams, endpoint teams, customer network engineers, and cloud teams during P1/P2 incidents to restore
critical services rapidly.

Conduct detailed RCA for latency, packet drops, authentication path failures, and internet reachability issues using Wireshark,
MTR, iPerf, and telemetry tools.


Managed escalations from L1/L2 teams and collaborated with engineering for product defect isolation and service-impacting


Delivered detailed technical RCA and uptime restoration planning for customer production incidents.

Troubleshot WLAN instability, roaming failures, RF interference, DHCP/VLAN issues, Layer2/Layer3 reachability failures, and


Supported post-change validation, network health monitoring, and customer-impacting outage coordination in 24x7 support
operations.


Performed L1/L2 troubleshooting of enterprise IP circuits and WAN services for Severity 2/3 outages including packet loss,


Monitored customer WAN links, internet provider incidents, and transmission outages while coordinating with telecom carriers
including AT&T;, Verizon, and Comcast.

Investigated traceroute asymmetry, route degradation, backbone interruptions, and business service outages using systematic


Maintained uptime through provider escalations, incident prioritization, and cross-functional outage management.

Worked on 4G telecom transmission rollout, optical backhaul readiness, transmission connectivity implementation, and telecom
